title: BehaviorTrendSeries
description: One player's retained add/drop history from the append-only behaviour store, carrying the points the in-season momentum sparkline draws (ADR-089). Behaviour, never a price: an add count is a number of roster transactions inside a declared lookback window, it is never converted into a draft position, and no field here may move a projection, a fair rank, a tier or a rest-of-season value. One record per player rather than per preset, because the same transactions are observed however points are scored.

behavior_source_id.description: Which behaviour feed supplied the counts. `sleeper` in Release 2.

lookback_hours.description: The window every point in this series was REQUESTED over. Sleeper publishes nothing about the window it actually used. Null when the retained captures disagree, because a 6-hour count and a 24-hour count are different quantities and a series may not silently mix them.

request_limit.description: The feed depth requested. It is what gives an absent day a ceiling: a player with no point that day was outside the top N, so his count was at most the smallest count that did appear.

window_days.description: The trailing window this series was cut from. Points may be fewer than the window allows; that is the series being young, not the window changing.

snapshots_in_window.description: Retained snapshots inside the window, whether or not they carried this player. `snapshots_in_window - observations` is how many days he was outside the feed's top N.

observations.description: Points in this series, of either side. Always equal to the length of `points`.

observation_days.description: Distinct calendar days carrying an observation. Two captures on one day are two observations and one observation day.

span_days.description: Elapsed days between the first and last point of either side. A trend is printed with its own series' span (add_span_days, net_span_days), never this one: a slope presented without the span it was measured over is the defect the behaviour trend rule exists to prevent.

add_trend.description: OLS slope of add_count on days elapsed, in transactions per day, over the points whose add side was OBSERVED (behavior_trend_v2, ADR-114) - add_observations of them, spanning add_span_days. Positive means the count is rising. Null with a single observation, because a line needs two points. NOT negated: unlike an ADP, a bigger add count is straightforwardly more interest.

net_trend.description: The same slope over net_add_count, fitted only over the points where BOTH sides were observed (net_observations of them, spanning net_span_days). Null below two such points. A day with one side outside its feed has no net and is never filled.

add_observations.description: Contract 2.0: points whose add_count was observed - the series add_trend was fitted over.

add_span_days.description: Elapsed days between the first and last observed add_count. Printed beside add_trend.

net_observations.description: Points with both sides observed - the series net_trend was fitted over.

net_span_days.description: Elapsed days between the first and last point with both sides observed. Printed beside net_trend.

quality_flags.description: `single_observation` when fewer than two add counts were observed; `sparse_feed_coverage` when the window held snapshots this player did not appear in; `one_sided_points` when some point carries only one side.

points.description: Ascending by observed_at. One point per retained snapshot in which EITHER feed carried this player; a side its feed did not carry is null (contract 2.0, ADR-114). A snapshot that carried him in neither feed produces NO point — the feed is a top-N list, so an absence is an unknown count rather than a zero, and filling it with zero would manufacture a collapse in interest out of a player leaving a leaderboard.

observed_at.description: When the snapshot was taken. Sleeper publishes no observation time of its own, so this is the retrieval instant and is not a data-as-of claim.

add_count.description: Null when the add feed did not carry him at this instant: outside its top 100, or not retrieved. Never 0 for an absence.

drop_count.description: Null when the drop feed did not carry him at this instant. Never 0 for an absence.

net_add_count.description: add_count minus drop_count, null unless both were observed. Legitimate for the narrow reason the Opportunity Board already relies on: both sides are the same unit, over the same window, from the same feed, at the same moment.
